On boss right rear corner of extension

notes: The vehicle identification number is stamped on both the engine and the transmission of every car.
VIN example 1 8 F 100001: 1 = Chevrolet division, 8 = model year, F = assembly plant, 100001 = sequential serial number.
At plants building more than one Chevrolet series, VIN sequences are staggered so component numbers never repeat (Los Angeles example: 15000-16000 series start at 100001, 12000 series at 500001).
Plant prefixes on units let GM trace a unit back to the plant that built it; quote these numbers on product reports.
4 and 6 cylinder engine locations on the chart are omitted (not Corvette).
